body:
Step 2b of docs/ios-port-design.md. Strings and drawables become Compose Multiplatform resources
(composeResources/values*/strings.xml in the nine locales, drawables as vector XML), still inside
:app or a first :shared skeleton, used through Res.string / Res.drawable. Code outside composition
(notifications, workers, view models producing UiText) reads them through the resources API.
crossClient.test.ts and every string guard follow the new path. No user-visible change; the
launcher icon and other Android-only resources stay in res/.
title: iPhone port step 2b: strings and drawables as Compose resources
